Mathematical_Definition: Number of non-zero singular values sigma_k > epsilon * sigma_1 of local Jacobian J(m_0)
Interpretation_and_Limits: Proves only that at the specific baseline point m_0, the linearized sensitivity matrix has no zero singular values. DOES NOT PROVE global invertibility.

Mathematical_Definition: Condition number kappa = sigma_max / sigma_min of local Jacobian J(m_0)
Interpretation_and_Limits: Quantifies local eccentricity of quadratic misfit surface around m_0. Both options are well-conditioned (kappa << 100), ensuring rapid gradient descent convergence locally.

Mathematical_Definition: Posterior uncertainty sigma_m,j = sqrt((FIM^-1)_jj) relative to admissible physical range Delta m
Option_A_Value: Practically Identifiable under regional uniformity prior
Option_B_Value: Practically Identifiable with independent flowline gate velocities
Interpretation_and_Limits: Depends on observation SNR. With gate velocity SNR ~ 6-15, parameters are bounded within narrow confidence intervals, but remain vulnerable to systematic geometric errors.

Mathematical_Definition: F(m_1) = F(m_2) <=> m_1 = m_2 for all m in parameter domain M
Option_B_Value: UNPROVEN GLOBALLY (Non-linear ice dynamics may have non-convex ridges)
Interpretation_and_Limits: CRITICAL SCIENTIFIC CORRECTION: Full numerical rank at m_0 does NOT guarantee global uniqueness. Non-linear forward models may contain local minima or distant equifinality valleys.

Mathematical_Definition: 3-parameter model: Shared regional C_bed, theta_buttress on Ryder, regional C_schoof
Interpretation_and_Limits: Hypothesis: Basal sliding friction is regionally homogeneous across the Peninsula. Parsimonious, but ignores known geological lithology contrasts between Graham Land and Larsen embayments.

Mathematical_Definition: 5-parameter model: Flowline-specific C_bed (HPI, IIPP, IPPJ), theta_buttress, C_schoof
Interpretation_and_Limits: Hypothesis: Basal sliding friction is governed by local fjord geology and till conditions. Physically superior, full rank (5/5), well-conditioned; must NOT be rejected merely because kappa is slightly higher.
